This '''sail barge''' was a [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|Luxury sail barge]] that was owned the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] crime lord, [[Centa Sonhan]]. It was [[Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after Sonhan captured the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]].
